label: Edge Repair
blurb: Covers damaged lines along the edges of the picture without cropping or zooming: the torn noise strip at the bottom of a tape capture, black or garbage lines a capture card leaves at the sides, a half line at the top of old broadcast video. Each edge takes a number of lines, filled by repeating the last good line, mirroring the picture, or repeating it more softly further out. Head Switching adds the torn strip; this hides it.
